major_cooldowns.name: Evangelism
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: The raid ramp anchor: build Atonement with Penance, Power Word: Shield, Plea and Flash Heal, then Evangelism into your Power Word: Radiance casts to reach 20 Atonements before the damage event, and in dungeons bank its two instant Radiance charges for mobility-heavy moments since the buff does not expire.

major_cooldowns.name: Ultimate Penitence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Ramp Atonement onto the group first, then cast it on an enemy target so every bolt converts to Atonement healing; as Voidweaver fire it inside a rift window unless you are holding it to bridge to the next Entropic Rift.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 421543 shares the name and is the aura/effect id; 421453 is the cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Power Word: Barrier
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: The alternative to Ultimate Penitence on its choice node: drop it on a stacked group for the 20% damage reduction whenever incoming damage over its 10 seconds is heavy enough to beat the Atonement throughput you give up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 81782 shares the name; 62618 is the castable 3 min version.

major_cooldowns.name: Power Infusion
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Never cast it on yourself: with Twins of the Sun Priestess you get the full 20% haste anyway, so align every cast with a damage dealer's cooldowns.

major_cooldowns.name: Mindbender
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fires automatically off Evangelism when talented, so plan Evangelism windows around it and feed the pet Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death casts for Inescapable Torment hits.

major_cooldowns.name: Pain Suppression
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: 40% damage reduction on one ally: put it on the tank for a scripted hit or on a player carrying a heavy damage-over-time effect, and with Protector of the Frail spend the extra charge freely rather than sitting at cap.

rule.description: Evangelism ramp: Flash Heal, Evangelism, Radiance
rule.action: Refresh Shadow Word: Pain so it covers the whole ramp, build Atonement with Penance, Power Word: Shield and Plea, then a single Flash Heal for the double Atonement from Binding Heals, then Evangelism into 1-2 Power Word: Radiance casts to reach 20 Atonements before you turn on damage with Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death.

rule.description: Spend Void Shield before the next Penance
rule.action: Cast Void Shield before your next Penance whenever the proc is up. Penance guarantees one proc every three casts, so sitting on it risks overwriting; cast it on yourself for the larger shield and more reflected damage.

rule.description: Penance consumes Power of the Dark Side
rule.action: Send Penance while Power of the Dark Side is up: the proc adds 30% effectiveness, and Mind Blast plus Shadow Word: Pain keep feeding it faster than you can bank it.

rule.description: Instant cast during Ultimate Penitence liftoff
rule.action: Weave a free instant into the float-up between the Ultimate Penitence cast and its channel: Power Word: Shield normally, or Shadow Word: Death if the target is in execute range. It does not cancel the channel.
